{% doc %} Renders the selected color gallery and accessible full-screen images. @param {product} product - Product whose media is shown @param {string} section_id - Unique parent section ID {% enddoc %} {%- liquid assign selected_variant = product.selected_or_first_available_variant assign selected_color = '' assign color_index = 0 for option in product.options_with_values assign option_name = option.name | downcase if option_name == 'color' or option_name == 'colour' assign color_index = option.position | minus: 1 assign selected_color = selected_variant.options[color_index] | handleize endif endfor -%}
{%- for media in product.media -%} {%- liquid assign item_color = '' for variant in product.variants if variant.featured_media.id == media.id assign item_color = variant.options[color_index] | handleize break endif endfor if media.alt contains '#color_' assign item_color = media.alt | split: '#color_' | last | split: ' ' | first | handleize endif assign is_visible = true if selected_color != blank and item_color != blank and item_color != selected_color assign is_visible = false endif assign clean_alt = media.alt | split: '#color_' | first | strip | default: product.title assign media_loading = 'lazy' if media.id == selected_variant.featured_media.id or forloop.first assign media_loading = 'eager' endif -%}
{%- case media.media_type -%} {%- when 'image' -%} {%- capture studio_url -%}{%- render 'studio-image-url', image: media.preview_image, product: product, media_id: media.id -%}{%- endcapture -%} {%- assign studio_url = studio_url | strip -%} {%- if studio_url != blank -%} {%- else -%}{{ media.preview_image | image_url: width: 1800 | image_tag: loading: media_loading, widths: '600,900,1200,1500,1800', sizes: '(min-width: 900px) 50vw, 100vw', alt: clean_alt }}{%- endif -%} {{ 'commerce.gallery.enlarge' | t }} + {%- when 'video' -%}{{ media | video_tag: controls: true, preload: 'metadata', image_size: '1200x', class: 'product-gallery__video' }} {%- when 'external_video' -%}{{ media | external_video_tag: loading: 'lazy', class: 'product-gallery__video' }} {%- when 'model' -%}{{ media | model_viewer_tag: image_size: '1200x', reveal: 'interaction', toggleable: true }} {%- endcase -%}
